title: AdvAcctFrcstDisplayGroup - Tooling API
description: Represents information about the groups for the advanced account forecast set measures or dimensions. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

AdvAccountForecastSetId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AdvAccountForecastSetId.description: The forecast set associated with the advanced account forecast display group. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

AdvAcctFrcstDisplayGroupName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
AdvAcctFrcstDisplayGroupName.description: The name of the advanced account forecast group.

GroupType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
GroupType.description: Specifies the category for the display group. Possible value is: MEASURE

IsDefault.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDefault.description: Indicates whether the display group is the default group. The default value is false.

UserProfileId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UserProfileId.description: The profile for which the display group is applicable. This field is a relationship field.
